audit.audit_scope: 1000 fresh parameter samples from compiled rejection sampler with unchanged native proposal/acceptance law, different RNG stream; unchanged native.generate(**params) produces labels; every pair checked under8D4/palette.4 additional untouched native-random samples baseline. No offset filtering.

notes.author: host
notes.explanation: Uniform centre-entry stamping. Detect3x3rings and coloured centres; locate each matching unique solid bar. Step the entire motif by3cells along the visible centre-to-bar axis. Stamp the first copy whose CENTRE is inside the bar, then stop, even if its border crosses the far edge. Invalid diagonal, jump-over, off-grid or colliding scenes reject. NumPy target uses components and patch writes; independent gate subtracts tile-centre coordinates from per-colour cell sets, identifies rectangles and simulates a coordinate canvas. Only BG=palette[8] is specialised.
notes.constructor_review: Matches unchanged native draw(). Archived far-edge guard is a solver defect that stops the tile before it reaches a thin bar. Fixtures are aligned; native samples additionally contain offsets1and2. Tests preserve both overshoot cases and no aligned-only restriction is imposed.
notes.limitations: Declared intended mechanism is centre-entry. Aligned fixture demos alone do not refute every alternative stop convention; this limitation is explicit. Requires the native exclusive frame colour, unique solid bar per centre colour and noncolliding paths. No query-label access.
notes.sampling: Native joint rejection is slow. Audit uses distribution-equivalent compiled rejection proposals followed by unchanged native explicit rendering, plus4 untouched native-RNG samples. Proposal laws, acceptance parity, source hashes, rejection attempts and entry-offset histogram are retained. Native generator source unchanged.
notes.validation: Six tests passed: fixtures acrossD4/palette; thin-bar overshoot and thick offset2; query-label poisoning; reject archived wrong-stop demo; reject diagonal/jumped-bar inputs; D4-argument independence.1000sample audit recorded separately.

compiled_sampler_equivalence.rng: C++ mt19937; different random stream from Python. No seed-for-seed identity claimed.

outer_distribution.bar_colours: uniform ordered sample without replacement from{1,...,9}excluding8andframe
outer_distribution.pixel_colours: iid uniform bar colours, rejection-conditioned on every bar appearing at least once

acceptance.spacing: Exact common.overlaps(...,spacing=1) comparison for bars and original3x3tiles
acceptance.initial_tiles: Spacing guarantees all original tile footprints are background, so omitted redundant initial-input-canvas work cannot change acceptance.
acceptance.output_draw: Literal native per-cell output painting: require inbounds and background/own bar colour; recompute direction from centre after stamping; stop only when centre enters bar; reject diagonal or direction change.
acceptance.early_alignment: Necessary rejects only: centre inside both bands violates initial background requirement; centre in neither band is diagonal. All geometry random variables have already been drawn.

compiled_sampler_equivalence.equivalence: Both sample the same proposal massq and acceptance indicatorA, hence accepted parameter law q(z)*A(z)/sum_z q(z)*A(z). No aligned-offset constraints or selected family templates.

Every1000accepted parameter set is likewise checked accepted before native labels are used. Four untouched Python-RNG samples are independently checked underall8D4.
